channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Greg Monroe | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Greg Monroe from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Chris Cenac on Greg Monroe
item.description:
He still remembers being a young kid in New Orleans, attending Greg Monroe’s camp and feeling what it was like to be close to someone who had made it.

“I remember Greg Monroe had a camp out here one time and I was there. I was probably about 7, 8 years old,”

Chris Cenac on Greg Monroe, Jul 21, 2026. Source: Fox8Live.com.

item.title: Bobby Webster on Greg Monroe
item.description:
Raptors GM Bobby Webster on Greg Monroe signing:

“Greg’s a proven big man in this league. We believe Greg’s experience will be a great addition to not only our frontcourt, but to our team culture as we continue to build towards our goal of an NBA championship.”

Bobby Webster on Greg Monroe, Aug 14, 2018. Source: Twitter @WolstatSun.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Greg Monroe, Al Horford, Marcus Morris, Aron Baynes, Shane Larkin, Terry Rozier, Jaylen Brown, Jayson Tatum
item.description:
Danny Ainge:

“I’m excited about the playoffs. I really am. Like, Terry Rozier and Shane Larkin, this is their opportunity. And Jaylen [Brown] and Jayson [Tatum] and Marcus Morris and [Al] Horford and [Aron] Baynes and Greg Monroe, I mean, the whole group. These guys are looking forward to playing in the playoffs. And we have the luxury to give them a little bit of rest without taking them completely out of rhythm in these last four games, which is very rare to be able to do heading into the playoffs.”

Danny Ainge on Greg Monroe, Al Horford, Marcus Morris, Aron Baynes, Shane Larkin, Terry Rozier, Jaylen Brown, Jayson Tatum, Apr 5, 2018. Source: Boston Herald.

item.title: Marcus Morris on Greg Monroe
item.description:
Marcus Morris on Greg Monroe:

“I think that’s a great pickup for us....he’s well-respected around the league. I think he’s definitely gonna be a great piece for us.”

Marcus Morris on Greg Monroe, Feb 2, 2018. Source: Twitter @AdamHimmelsbach.

item.title: Jon Horst on Greg Monroe
item.description:
Jon Horst:

“I don’t buy into that. Greg Monroe’s a really good player. Greg was really productive for us on the floor, he’s a great person off the floor. He helped us have a lot of success here and we’re thankful for him and the things that he did for us in helping a young team grow. I think players like Greg Monroe have a role in this NBA without a doubt.”

Jon Horst on Greg Monroe, Nov 7, 2017. Source: Milwaukee Journal-Sentinel.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Greg Monroe
item.description:
Charles F. Gardner:Jason Kidd on shootaround injury (Greg Monroe):

“It was just an accident and it happens. You just wish doesn't happen to you on a road trip.”

Jason Kidd on Greg Monroe, Dec 16, 2015. Source: Twitter @cf_gardner.

item.title: John Hammond on Greg Monroe, John Henson, Jabari Parker, Khris Middleton, Michael Carter-Williams, Giannis Antetokounmpo
item.description:
John Hammond:

“We're trying to build around some kind of consistenty with the nucleus of Michael Carter-Williams, Khris Middleton, Jabari Parker, Giannis Antetokounmpo, Greg Monroe and John Henson. Those six guys are the young core that we look and say that's kinda the future of this organization,and that's not discounting anyone else. Other players have to step and become a part of that group with us. But those guys are the group we hope we can build some kind of continuity with.”

John Hammond on Greg Monroe, John Henson, Jabari Parker, Khris Middleton, Michael Carter-Williams, Giannis Antetokounmpo, Aug 21, 2015. Source: Brew Hoop.

item.title: David Falk on Greg Monroe
item.description:
David Aldridge:Falk, on Bucks:

“He (Monroe) thinks they've done a great job of putting together a roster--a pretty deep roster.”

David Falk on Greg Monroe, Jul 2, 2015. Source: Twitter @daldridgetnt.

item.title: Stan Van Gundy on Greg Monroe
item.description:
“That was a great combination on the offensive end of the floor, especially when the three guys around them were shooters – more conventional perimeter types. That worked very, very well. Now, it didn't work very well defensively. I think it puts a lot of responsibility on Greg Monroe to have to guard out on the perimeter.”

Stan Van Gundy on Greg Monroe, Jun 2, 2014. Source: Booth Newspapers.

item.title: Monty Williams on Greg Monroe
item.description:
“I believe the NBA needs to look at that play and maybe suspend Monroe because it was a violent play that should have been penalized and the refs didn’t catch it,”

Monty Williams on Greg Monroe, Feb 7, 2012. Source: WWLTV.com.
